Context Engineering Protocol

Human-approved, source-attributed context package before an AI agent writes a line of code.

Retrofit a Skill Library

Point at a skill library inside this repo to see which of its skills look code-related or task-related, select which CEP contract(s) each one should reference, and draft a pointer to insert. Every draft is deterministic template text, always editable, and nothing is written to any file yet.

1. Pick a target directory

Browsing is read-only. Click a directory to open it, then "Inventory this directory" to scan it as a candidate skill library.

.

    2. Inventory, select, and draft

    Expand a unit, adjust its contracts/reference if needed, then click "Save selection & draft". Each successful draft is added to the batch in step 3 below - repeat for as many units as you want in this batch.

        3. Review the batch

        Every unit below has a saved, drafted insertion. Uncheck a card to leave it out of the batch. "Apply changes" writes every remaining checked card to disk, one file at a time - a failure on one file is reported for that file and never aborts the rest of the batch, and re-applying the same batch afterwards is safe (already-written units are reported as skipped, not duplicated).

            Let's find this repo's layout

            This repo hasn't run ult-repo-layout init yet, so there's no context-config.yaml for Discover to write proposals into. init is a short conversational step with your coding agent — it asks for this project's name and description, and (optionally) whether its content lives in a separate workspace root — it never guesses these from existing files. Run /ult-repo-layout init whenever you're ready.

            You can run Discover below before or after init — order doesn't change what Discover finds, but running init first gives the Guidelines box a real base instead of defaults.

            This repo's layout hasn't been discovered yet. Discover scans the repo and proposes a decision for each layer (What, How, and any opt-in dimensions) — nothing is written into context-config.yaml until you review and Apply those decisions on the next screen.
